parsed.internal_thinking: Claude is offering me 1 Sheep for 1 Wood. Looking at my current resources based on the game state (ג'ימי: W:2, Wh:2, S:2), I have 2 Wood. My immediate goal is to settle node 31, which requires 1 Wood, 1 Brick, 1 Wheat, and 1 Sheep. I currently have the Wood, Wheat, and Sheep, but I'm missing the Brick. While I have surplus Wood, giving it to Claude (who needs resources to expand or buy dev cards) doesn't help me get the Brick I need. More importantly, Claude has been actively hostile and trying to isolate me. Accepting a trade from him now might undermine my solid alliance with Gemma, who just built a city and is my primary trading partner. I'll reject this to keep my Wood for my own settlement and avoid helping Claude.
parsed.note_to_self: Rejected Claude's Sheep-for-Wood trade. I have 2 Wood, 2 Wheat, 2 Sheep. Need 1 Brick for node 31 settlement. Gemma is a better ally; Claude is still looking for ways to block me.
parsed.say_outloud: לא תודה, קלוד. אני שומר את ה-עץ שלי בינתיים. נראה לי שאתה צריך אותו יותר ממה שאני צריך עוד כבשה.
